The '''Simpla system''' contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Simpla-12]] and the primary star [[Simpla-12|Simpla]]. It was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|''Jedi Apprentice'']] books place the Simpla system in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region, but ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the system in the Outer Rim. This article assumes that the more recent ''Atlas'' is correct.
